name: Hub-and-spoke network topology
short_description: Network design in which a central hub virtual network hosts shared services such as a firewall or VPN gateway and is peered with many spoke virtual networks that hold individual workloads.

evidence.quote: So how do you handle this at scale? You use a hub and spoke architecture.
The most common approach is called hub and spoke architecture, picture a bicycle wheel.
The old model is the hub and spoke topology.
The traditional approach in Azure is called hub and spoke.
You can make HubSpoke set up if you want, just with one set up.
an architectural intervention, centered on a mandatory hub-spoke model.
